hypothesis.statement: On a real eyes-closed posterior EEG channel (eegmmidb S002R02, POz), the newly-authored tsallisEntropy reproduces NeuroKit2 entropy_tsallis BIT-FOR-BIT across q = {0.5, 1, 2, 3}; at q=1 it equals the Shannon entropy AND the Renyi entropy (the two generalizations coincide there), while at q=2 it diverges from the Renyi entropy (non-additive vs additive); and it is non-increasing in q.

analysis_plan.dataset: EEG Motor Movement/Imagery Database (eegmmidb, PhysioNet), subject S002, baseline run R02 (eyes-closed), channel POz (posterior), first 10 s at 160 Hz (1600 samples)

decision.threshold: descriptive: tsallisEntropy equals NeuroKit2 entropy_tsallis to machine precision (max |diff| < 1e-9) across q; at q=1 it equals the Renyi entropy; at q=2 it differs from it
